title: LOD Level Comparison Viewer
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements an interactive Level-of-Detail (LOD) comparison viewer displaying two GLB models side by side with configurable LOD simulation.

SCENE SETUP:
- Use a WebGLRenderer with antialias, size 1200x700, background color #1a1a2e.
- Create TWO viewports (left and right) using scissor testing. Each viewport occupies exactly half the canvas width. Left viewport: x=0, width=600. Right viewport: x=600, width=600. Both full height 700.
- Add a vertical white divider line (DOM element, 2px wide) at the center of the canvas.
- Each viewport has its own PerspectiveCamera (fov=45, near=0.1, far=1000) and its own OrbitControls.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.5) and a directional light at (5,10,7) with intensity 1.2 to the scene.
- The scene is shared but each model is positioned separately: left model at (-2, 0, 0), right model at (2, 0, 0).

MODEL LOADING:
- Load 'DiffuseTransmissionTeacup.glb' using GLTFLoader and place it in the LEFT viewport area at position (-2, 0, 0). Auto-scale it to fit within a 2-unit bounding sphere.
- Load 'CesiumMan.glb' using GLTFLoader and place it in the RIGHT viewport area at position (2, 0, 0). Auto-scale it to fit within a 2-unit bounding sphere. If it has animations, play the first animation using an AnimationMixer.
- After loading, center each model vertically so it sits at y=0 based on its bounding box center.

LOD SIMULATION SYSTEM:
- Implement 4 LOD levels: 'Ultra' (LOD 0), 'High' (LOD 1), 'Medium' (LOD 2), 'Low' (LOD 3).
- Each model can have its LOD level set independently.
- LOD simulation is achieved by modifying the rendered appearance:
  - LOD 0 (Ultra): Original geometry, full material (no changes).
  - LOD 1 (High): Wireframe overlay disabled, but reduce material roughness by 0.1 (clamp 0-1). Geometry unchanged.
  - LOD 2 (Medium): Enable wireframe mode on all meshes of the model.
  - LOD 3 (Low): Enable wireframe mode AND reduce geometry detail by hiding every other child mesh (if multiple meshes exist), or set material opacity to 0.4 with transparent=true.
- Track the current LOD level for each model separately.

LOD DISTANCE AUTO MODE:
- Implement an auto-LOD mode toggled by pressing 'A'. When enabled, each model's LOD level is determined by the distance from its respective camera:
  - distance < 3: LOD 0
  - 3 <= distance < 6: LOD 1
  - 6 <= distance < 10: LOD 2
  - distance >= 10: LOD 3
- When auto-LOD is off, manual LOD controls apply.

USER INTERACTIONS:
- Keyboard '1','2','3','4': Set LEFT model LOD to 0,1,2,3 respectively (only when auto-LOD is off).
- Keyboard Shift+'1','2','3','4': Set RIGHT model LOD to 0,1,2,3 respectively (only when auto-LOD is off).
- Keyboard 'A': Toggle auto-LOD mode on/off.
- Keyboard 'L': Toggle camera link mode. When linked, both cameras mirror the same orbit position/target.
- Keyboard 'R': Reset both cameras to default position (0, 2, 8) looking at their respective model centers.
- Keyboard 'S': Take a snapshot of current state and push to a comparison history array (max 10 entries).
- DOM button 'Toggle Stats': Show/hide a stats panel displaying triangle counts, draw calls for each viewport.

HUD / UI:
- Top-left overlay: 'Left Model: [name] | LOD: [level_name]' 
- Top-right overlay: 'Right Model: [name] | LOD: [level_name]'
- Bottom-center overlay: 'Auto-LOD: [ON/OFF] | Linked Cameras: [ON/OFF] | Snapshots: [count]'
- A DOM button with id='toggleStats' labeled 'Toggle Stats' in the top-center.
- Stats panel (id='statsPanel', hidden by default): shows triangleCountLeft, triangleCountRight, drawCalls.

STATE MANAGEMENT (window.__3D_STATE__):
Expose the following on every animation frame:
{
  modelsLoaded: number (0, 1, or 2),
  leftModelName: string,
  rightModelName: string,
  leftLOD: number (0-3),
  rightLOD: number (0-3),
  autoLOD: boolean,
  camerasLinked: boolean,
  leftCameraDistance: number (distance from left camera to left model),
  rightCameraDistance: number (distance from right camera to right model),
  leftWireframe: boolean,
  rightWireframe: boolean,
  leftOpacity: number (material opacity of left model, 0-1),
  rightOpacity: number (material opacity of right model, 0-1),
  snapshotCount: number,
  snapshots: array of {leftLOD, rightLOD, timestamp},
  statsVisible: boolean,
  triangleCountLeft: number,
  triangleCountRight: number,
  animationPlaying: boolean (true if CesiumMan animation is running),
  rendererInfo: { drawCalls: number, triangles: number },
  frameCount: number
}
physics_constraints: No physics simulation. LOD distance thresholds must be strictly enforced: <3 → LOD0, [3,6) → LOD1, [6,10) → LOD2, >=10 → LOD3. Camera distances must be computed as Euclidean distance. Opacity values clamped [0,1]. Triangle counts must be non-negative integers.
